research.searchCoverage: Official BetterContact API v2 at https://app.bettercontact.rocks/api/v2, X-API-Key header, GET /account (rate-limit exempt, no credit spend), GET /async/{request_id}, Lyon SAS identity in terms, and dated incident search for BetterContact / bettercontact.rocks security breach reviewed on 2026-09-13. GetContact and Covve contact-app incidents are distinct companies. POST /async enrichment is billed and omitted. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official docs require X-API-Key on https://app.bettercontact.rocks/api/v2. GET /account is documented as rate-limit exempt and does not consume credits, so it is the healthcheck. GET /async/{request_id} fetches a previously submitted enrichment and is not itself a billed lookup. Operator is BETTERCONTACT SAS, Lyon. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying unresolved BetterContact compromise.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of BetterContact / bettercontact.rocks security breach coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-credential compromise. GetContact (caller-ID app) and Covve contact-management incidents are distinct companies.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
